patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,9 +1,104 @@
-class BowlingGame:
-    def __init__(self):
-        pass
-
-    def roll(self, pins):
-        pass
-
-    def score(self):
-        pass
+class BowlingGame:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.rolls = []
+        self.current_frame = 1
+        self.frame_rolls = 0  # rolls in current frame
+        self.is_complete = False
+        
+    def roll(self, pins):
+        if self.is_complete:
+            raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is complete")
+            
+        if pins < 0:
+            raise ValueError("Negative roll is invalid")
+            
+        if pins > 10:
+            raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+            
+        # Check if this roll is valid based on previous roll in the same frame
+        if self.frame_rolls == 1 and self.current_frame < 10:
+            # In frames 1-9, if first roll wasn't a strike, second roll can't exceed remaining pins
+            if self.rolls[-1] < 10 and self.rolls[-1] + pins > 10:
+                raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+        elif self.current_frame == 10:
+            # Handle 10th frame special cases
+            if len(self.rolls) >= 1 and self.rolls[-1] == 10:
+                # First roll was a strike
+                if len(self.rolls) == 2 and self.rolls[0] == 10 and self.rolls[1] == 10:
+                    # Two strikes, third roll can be 0-10
+                    pass
+                elif len(self.rolls) == 2 and self.rolls[0] == 10 and self.rolls[1] < 10:
+                    # First strike, second roll < 10, third roll can't exceed remaining
+                    if self.rolls[1] + pins > 10 and self.rolls[1] != 10:
+                        raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+                elif len(self.rolls) == 1:
+                    # Just first strike, second roll can be 0-10
+                    pass
+            elif len(self.rolls) >= 1 and self.rolls[-1] < 10:
+                # First roll wasn't a strike
+                if len(self.rolls) == 1 and self.rolls[0] + pins > 10:
+                    raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+                elif len(self.rolls) == 2 and self.rolls[0] < 10 and self.rolls[0] + self.rolls[1] == 10:
+                    # Spare in first two rolls, third roll can be 0-10
+                    pass
+                elif len(self.rolls) == 2 and self.rolls[0] + self.rolls[1] < 10:
+                    # Open frame, third roll would be invalid
+                    if self.rolls[0] + self.rolls[1] + pins > 10:
+                        raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+        
+        self.rolls.append(pins)
+        self.frame_rolls += 1
+        
+        # Update frame state
+        if self.current_frame < 10:
+            # Frames 1-9
+            if (self.frame_rolls == 2 and self.rolls[-2] + self.rolls[-1] < 10) or \
+               (self.frame_rolls == 1 and self.rolls[-1] == 10):  # Strike
+                self.current_frame += 1
+                self.frame_rolls = 0
+        else:
+            # Frame 10 - special handling
+            if len(self.rolls) == 3 or \
+               (len(self.rolls) == 2 and self.rolls[0] + self.rolls[1] < 10) or \
+               (len(self.rolls) == 1 and self.rolls[0] < 10):
+                self.is_complete = True
+    
+    def score(self):
+        if not self.is_complete:
+            raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+            
+        total_score = 0
+        roll_index = 0
+        
+        # Score frames 1-9
+        for frame in range(9):
+            if roll_index >= len(self.rolls):
+                break
+                
+            frame_score = self.rolls[roll_index]
+            
+            # Check for strike
+            if self.rolls[roll_index] == 10:
+                # Strike: 10 + next two rolls
+                if roll_index + 2 < len(self.rolls):
+                    frame_score += self.rolls[roll_index + 1] + self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                roll_index += 1
+            else:
+                # Not a strike
+                if roll_index + 1 < len(self.rolls):
+                    frame_score += self.rolls[roll_index + 1]
+                    # Check for spare
+                    if self.rolls[roll_index] + self.rolls[roll_index + 1] == 10:
+                        # Spare: 10 + next roll
+                        if roll_index + 2 < len(self.rolls):
+                            frame_score += self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                roll_index += 2
+                
+            total_score += frame_score
+            
+        # Score frame 10
+        while roll_index < len(self.rolls):
+            total_score += self.rolls[roll_index]
+            roll_index += 1
+            
+        return total_score
